# Crunch Republic

> Build Your Own, Top It, Love It. Quick-service modern dining experience featuring burgers, loaded fries, corn dogs, pastas, mocktails, and thick shakes.

## Core Features
- Live QR Table Ordering: Scan table QR code to view live categorized menu and place orders directly to the kitchen.
- Real-time Order Tracking: Customers view order statuses (received, cooking, served, paid) via live WebSocket updates.
- Flexible Checkout: Table-side cash settlement and instant online UPI QR payment.
- Corporate Desk Delivery: Scan office QR code with dedicated desk routing.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Socket.IO Client.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), Socket.IO.
- Hosting & Delivery: High-performance single page application with WebP imagery.
